status: Implemented and locally validated; strict matched profile intentionally blocked; B200 production qualification unverified
scope: Only dflash and its explicitly managed vendor patches; SpecNaacl read-only

correctness_fixes.problem: Feedback q was reconstructed using a different head reduction and omitted actual logit processing.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: Recomputed H @ head may differ from model.compute_logits (BF16 rounding, bias, scaling, processors).
correctness_fixes.solution: Retain the exact raw proposal logits until verification; map original rows across request reordering; fuse teacher-coordinate q into union using A_t/U_t/B_t. Never copy B or run a second head forward. Reject stale B/A/head versions.

correctness_fixes.problem: Greedy proposals computed full top-k/normalization for every slot.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: Proposal selection and learning statistics shared the same full-vocabulary path unconditionally.
correctness_fixes.solution: Keep Candidate A and add Candidate B corrected argmax followed by masked valid-row statistics. Preserve serial FP32 correction order, disabled FP fusion and minimum-token-ID ties. Select from complete hot-path calibration rather than isolated argmax.

correctness_fixes.problem: Teacher top-k ties could change the selected operational gradient.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: torch.topk does not guarantee SpecNaacl minimum-ID boundary ties; selected coordinates matter even when probabilities tie.
correctness_fixes.solution: Canonicalize K+1 teacher candidates. Only positive K/K+1 boundary ties scan ascending vocabulary IDs. Masked teacher scan uses the same tie rule; zero-probability teacher-only coordinates are excluded as in SpecNaacl.

correctness_fixes.problem: Unused feedback slots still consumed vocabulary work; greedy teachers needlessly required a dense one-hot tensor.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: All padded/post-rejection rows passed through teacher top-k and draft statistics.
correctness_fixes.solution: GPU masks return before expensive vocabulary loads on invalid rows. Benchmark masked versus full teacher top-k; greedy p is an argmax delta without a new dense one-hot allocation. Use actual sampler decisions, cap/EOS/variable-length/request masks.

correctness_fixes.problem: Growing host density bound could force dense correction on repeatedly visited token IDs.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: n * 2 * K per round counts duplicate IDs repeatedly and is not active-row density.
correctness_fixes.solution: Unique GPU active bitmap/count and compact IDs; GPU threshold branch reads actual active_count. GPU counters record chosen backends and materialize only at cohort boundaries. Unknown hardware/shape stays sparse. Legacy measured fused cache migrates; no arbitrary vocab/8 threshold or automatic GEMM. Calibration keys distinguish actual raw logits dtype from hidden dtype; mismatched buckets are not reused.

correctness_fixes.problem: A learning, update order, skipped steps and resume needed an explicit invariant audit.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: Selective reconstruction must precede mutation; target/draft/A cadence must be read from actual source rather than the accumulation label.
correctness_fixes.modified_file_function: kernels.py::feedback; vllm_runtime.py::Runtime.finish; metrics.py; existing ProjectorTrainer/optimizer boundary hooks retained
correctness_fixes.solution: Compute A numerator from B_t before sparse B updates; accumulate FP32/global valid weight; A stays persistent and trainable, B shared within one cohort and reset only between cohorts. Preserve pending feedback on unsuccessful joint steps and checkpoint optimizer/scheduler/RNG/version. One A update per successful native joint boundary, not one update per four cohorts.

correctness_fixes.problem: KL=0, clip=.2 and NeMo score-factor gradients did not match the intended Spec target loss.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: Equal coefficients alone do not match sequence reduction, on-policy ratio, KL clamping or the score-factor gradient.
correctness_fixes.solution: Default BETA=.04/EPSILON=.1 reach the actual loss. specnaacl_sequence uses sequence mean, detached-current old logp for the one on-policy pass, unclamped k3 and direct Spec KL gradient. original_nemo retains the old four-key loss contract for reproducibility/resume.

correctness_fixes.problem: Full-target training and native physical microbatching could be mislabeled SpecNaacl matched.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: Pinned Bridge LoRA shares input factors for fused QKV/gate-up; native joint optimizer does not express the requested independent four-cohort target accumulation. Filtering/masks also differ.
correctness_fixes.solution: Strict specnaacl_matched preflight fails before GPU/model access, including dry run. native_dflash is explicit and valid as a native profile. Reject unsupported LoRA overrides, legacy token budgets and multi-epoch GRPO knobs rather than silently accepting them. Produce a stdlib-only matrix from actual shell/source/resolved config.

correctness_fixes.problem: Production baseline paid for Reflex instrumentation and could expose fabricated AAL zeros.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: Unconditional Python wrappers, acceptance-history and GPU counter allocation for METHOD=dflash.
correctness_fixes.solution: Import process flags once. Production baseline directly follows original forward/proposer/sampler path without optional wrapper, GPU acceptance buffer or OPD state. instrumented mode gives both methods identical core sampler metrics. Missing production metrics stay null, including cumulative metrics after resume.

correctness_fixes.problem: Whitespace handling and the vLLM seed could diverge from the source data/reward contract.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: Unconditional answer strip and node/bundle seed do not match SpecNaacl extraction/experiment seed.
correctness_fixes.solution: Preserve original whitespace unless extracting after ####; verify question/gold/subset/template and actual math-verify reward on shared synthetic records/completions for all three datasets. Engine seed uses TRAIN_SUBSET_SEED. Retain and disclose native missing-gold/overlength/group-normalization differences.

correctness_fixes.problem: Diagnostics could produce Inf on underflow and incomplete wall/metric totals on resume.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: log(0) diagnostic and last-iteration wall time omit final checkpoint drain; absent counters do not mean zero.
correctness_fixes.solution: Floor only q in reported KL logs at FP32 tiny, leaving operational q-p untouched. Keep final complete wall time, actual cohort/response/successful-step/A/B counters, reward/losses and checkpoint continuity. Fused or unmeasured profile components are null rather than invented timings.

correctness_fixes.problem: Qwen3-4B tied heads and inference-mode tensors needed runtime-safe handling.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: Tied model checkpoint may not contain lm_head.weight, and inference tensors lack version counters.
correctness_fixes.modified_file_function: prepare_run.py (model.embed_tokens.weight fallback); adapter.py/kernels.py (normal persistent tensors); vllm_runtime.py::tensor_version
correctness_fixes.solution: Initialize A from the actual tied head when configured; allocate persistent versioned A/scratch outside inference mode; retain raw logits so head recomputation is unnecessary. Enforce refit at existing cohort boundaries.
correctness_fixes.validation_limit: Tied-head fallback inspected statically; no real target checkpoint available to execute that loader.

correctness_fixes.problem: Explicit dense GEMM feedback could reconstruct a different correction than the proposal used.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: GEMM and serial Triton sums need not round identically; computing teacher q with a second reduction violates the exact proposal-distribution contract.
correctness_fixes.solution: Store a view of the already allocated GEMM-corrected proposal buffer. Feedback gathers those exact logits with CORRECTED_RAW=True and never applies B a second time. A terms still read B_t. Automatic GEMM selection stays disabled.

correctness_fixes.problem: RESUME=auto could select a baseline or another dataset after running a comparison pair.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: A single per-model active_run symlink was shared across METHOD and DATASET.
correctness_fixes.solution: Maintain method/dataset-specific active links, prefer the matching link for auto resume and retain the previous legacy active_run fallback. Existing strict configuration validation still rejects an incompatible legacy checkpoint; nothing is silently reset.

correctness_fixes.problem: Training wall time excluded Ray/model setup, and null production counters could prevent carrying completed-session drain time into resume.
correctness_fixes.root_cause: Metrics clock began after setup; checkpoint/summary identity comparison required rounds even when production intentionally records rounds=null.
correctness_fixes.solution: Start the session clock at train.main, pass it across setup, include final checkpoint/worker shutdown, exclude downtime between resumes. Compare only available identity counters for final-summary drain recovery. Preserve historical checkpoint wall totals without inventing startup time missing from old runs.

tests.name: pytest
warnings: SciPy warns about development NumPy version; tested paths pass

performance.memory_scope: Peak allocated includes shared synthetic inputs and all candidate workspaces in this harness; retained logits lifetime reported separately.
performance.selection: Per-shape measured aggregate winner and previous completed-cohort feedback density; require >=5% advantage over fused. No knowledge of current future acceptance. Missing calibration defaults fused/sparse.
performance.numerical_contract: Exact proposal IDs in BF16/FP32, B=0/sparse/dense and near ties. FP64 gradient oracle: B rtol2e-5 atol3e-9; A rtol2e-5 atol5e-9. No automatic GEMM near-tie claim.

blockers: Target LoRA: pinned nemo_rl/models/megatron/setup.py constructs Bridge LoRA on fused linear_qkv/linear_fc1. This shares input factors across Q/K/V and gate/up, unlike seven independent PEFT rank-64 adapters. Canonical injection, merged vLLM refit and checkpoint round-trip have not been integrated/validated.

Requested four-rollout target accumulation with independent draft/A steps is not expressed by the pinned joint Megatron target+draft optimizer. Raising train_global_batch_size does not implement it. Actual local SpecNaacl calls target.step after each nonempty filtered rollout, despite ACCUMULATION_STEPS=4.

SpecNaacl excludes constant-reward groups from target only, uses population reward std without epsilon and retokenizes assistant messages; native NeMo keeps those samples and uses generated token masks. Their target denominator differs.
fairness.actual_spec_target: One target step per nonempty retained rollout, not four-rollout readiness; responses per step vary with target-only reward filtering.
fairness.supported_loss: Spec per-sequence clipped policy objective and direct k3 gradient for common supplied tensors; sample retention/reference adaptation/masks still differ.
fairness.lora: Native full target training; fused Bridge LoRA not substituted for independent PEFT adapters.
fairness.missing_source_config: SpecNaacl has no qwen3_8b model env; audit tool marks corresponding model/batch values UNVERIFIED rather than inventing values.

recommended_configuration.note: Calibration from the B200 host only. Native A weight decay 0 retained for compatibility and disclosed versus Spec .01. No strict cross-framework comparison claim.

preserved: Nine original model pretrain/train wrapper files
ShareGPT pretraining and actual NVIDIA block draft loss
Persistent trainable A and temporary shared B

production_validation.reason: RTX 3090/CUDA12 development runtime; required CUDA13 actor environments, Ray, B200 and configured local target/draft/data are absent.

wall_time_scope: New runs: train.main entry through checkpoint/worker shutdown, including Ray/model setup. Excludes separate pretrain, launcher preflight and downtime between resumed sessions. Historical missing startup time cannot be reconstructed.
